title: An empty Inactive tab says No inactive parts at this location.
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Loc Empty). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Location {Location-A} has no inactive parts at all (a newly created location has none).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EMPTY-01) is active at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Pick {Location-A} in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  3. Clear the Search box.
  4. Set Bin Location to All bin locations and Category to All categories.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Click the Active tab.
  7. Click the {Part-A} row.
  8. Pick Part Status → Inactive.
  9. Click Save.
  10. Click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  11. Click the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: In place of the list, the Inactive tab shows "No inactive parts at this location." and no rows.
  • Step 11: The Inactive tab now lists {Part-A}, and "No inactive parts at this location." is gone.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S1-N1, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.10 (Branch: no inactive parts), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
